summary: A Yes vote authorizes $6.1 million in general obligation bonds, repaid at an estimated $35 per $100,000 of assessed value, to fund campus building repairs and infrastructure improvements.

schools.text: The Yes campaign backs the bond to invest in facilities at Sunol Glen's district public school, calling it an investment in the school and community.
schools.quote: When we invest in the infrastructure of our school, of course we get a building
